description: Construction of Norochcholai - Wariyapola Transmission Line and Wariyapola Switching Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Several Transmission Development projects have been identified in the 2025-2034 Long-Term Transmission Plan prepared by the Ceylon Electricity Board and are scheduled to be implemented on priority basis. The Norochcholai - Wariyapola Transmission Development Project has been identified as a priority project to be implemented to utilize the renewable energy sources in the North Western region of the country. It is estimated that there is a renewable energy potential of more than 750 MW in the North Western region, and the objectives of this proposed Transmission Development Project are to establish a main transmission network to facilitate the integration of the variable renewable energy sources in that region into the national grid and to reduce congestion in the transmission network by transmitting possible bulk electricity generation around Puttalam. The estimated cost for the construction under the proposed project is Rs.24.06 billion, and the Department of National Planning has recommended that the project be implemented within the medium-term budgetary framework. It is expected to secure necessary funds for the project from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to implement the Norochcholai ‑ Wariyapola Transmission Development Project and to pursue action to secure funds required for the purpose from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.
